title: Add Open Functionality to Sketchpad for Synchronized Kits
description: Add Open functionality to the sketchpad to open synchronized kits. Implement different folder kinds: file kit opens a file picker, folder kit opens a folder picker, remote kit asks for a URL that connects to semio/server. Some folder kinds are only available in native environments such as semio/desktop. Make sure everything is tested end-to-end. Extend semio if necessary.
summary: Fixed folder-backed synchronized kit restore semantics. Sketchpad now persists local source metadata for folder/file/remote kits, restores source-backed kits on startup without invoking pickers, falls back to in-memory restore for legacy local snapshots without source metadata, and desktop folder/file factories reopen the exact stored source path instead of prompting again. Added desktop integration assertions for persisted source metadata and sketchpad regression tests covering source-based restore and no-picker legacy startup behavior.
